G1_unambiguity.justification: The module, incompatibility, consortium, selection, and output requirements have a single clear interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary input bounds, structural guarantees, output requirements, and relevant edge cases are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The rewrite preserves the original bipartite incompatibility condition and asks for exactly the same independent set of size k, while its additional structural constraints are automatic consequences of that condition.

G4_naturalness.justification: The orbital-module framing is coherent and readable, though the added consortium and extremal-edge conditions are somewhat unnecessary and contrived.
